origin.description: strtrim_ctl that treats only SGR sequences as controls.
origin.usage: strtrim_sgr(x, width, warn = getOption("fansi.warn", TRUE), normalize = getOption("fansi.normalize", FALSE), carry = getOption("fansi.carry", FALSE), terminate = getOption("fansi.terminate", TRUE))
origin.details: strtrim_ctl that treats only SGR sequences as controls. An omitted wrap width is 72, which is 0.9 times the default R width of 80.

translation.description: strtrim_ctl that treats only SGR sequences as controls.
translation.usage: strtrim_sgr(x, width, warn=None, normalize=None, carry=None, terminate=None)
translation.details: strtrim_ctl that treats only SGR sequences as controls. An omitted wrap width is 72. A string is one element. None is a missing string. Dotted R names are written with underscores.
translation.example:
from fansi.strtrim_ctl import strtrim_sgr
print(strtrim_sgr("\033[42mHello world\033[m", 6, warn=False)[0])
